name: Help Mate
overview: The concept of a 'Help Mate' is rooted in God's design for humanity, as seen in the creation of man and woman in His image (Genesis 1:27). Recognizing that it was not good for man to be alone, God created a suitable helper for Adam, fashioned from his own body to complement and support him (Genesis 2:18, 2:22). This divine arrangement establishes the foundation for marriage, where a man leaves his parents to unite with his wife, becoming one flesh in a covenant relationship (Genesis 2:24).
